title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Calculation - Protein
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A burn patient requires 2.0 g/kg of protein. If they weigh 165 lbs, approximately how many grams of protein should they consume daily?
questions.explain: First convert lbs to kg: $$165 / 2.2 = 75 \text{ kg}$$. Then multiply by requirement: $$75 \text{ kg} \times 2.0 \text{ g/kg} = 150 \text{ g}$$.
